comment: Renderer-neutral look values neither the lighting bible (lighting-bible.json) nor the rain pack (rain-bible.json) fixes, tuned for the owner's phone checks. Both renderers read them from here; nothing look-related is hard-coded in shaders or Swift (owner, 6 Oct). Change log: docs/look-spec-changes.md.

daytimeMaster.comment: Engine calibration only (owner, 7 Oct: look values come from mock-values.json, house-contrast-v1 sharedLighting). key and fill scale the clear-day sun and sky fill under the master so a neutral patch's shadow/lit linear luminance meets the master's 0.62 (shadows.strengthPercent 38). Measured on the simulator; see docs/look-spec-changes.md.

wetPaving.comment: Departure from rain-v1 (owner's phone check, 7 Oct): the pack's paving darkening x3.8, so steady rain darkens concrete ~38% and asphalt ~42%, light rain ~30%.

shadows.comment: Owner, 7 Oct: tree-crown shadows must reach the lawns; real shadows out to 120 m, 150 m at low sun (was 60 / 80 m), blob shadows only beyond. 150 m all day measured worse near the camera (one shadow map over 2.5x the ground: the nearest crown shadow softened and shrank, dark share 0.33 -> 0.25) for little gain past 60 m.
